headline: Executive order changes the earlier rules for how the federal government classifies and protects national security information.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12958, which sets the rules for classifying national security information. Those rules cover how information is marked secret, who may do so, how it is protected, and when it is declassified. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and officials who handle classified information
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the updated rules for classifying, protecting, and declassifying national security information.

who_it_affects.group: Researchers, journalists, and members of the public seeking government records
who_it_affects.how: Changes to declassification rules may affect which records become public and when.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 25, 2003; the available material does not state a separate effective date.
